images.prompt: Keeper of Hours — STARTER identity master, v4 (chin fix). One full-body figure, facing the camera (direction S), projection C (elevated three-quarter), standing, feet visible, weight even, arms relaxed, a plain wooden staff held upright in the RIGHT hand. Identity: a YOUNG WOMAN, early 20s, dark curly hair tied back, sun-browned skin, face fully visible, no helmet. FACE: a smooth, softly rounded chin with NO cleft and NO dimple; a soft feminine jawline; otherwise the same face as Image 1. Costume (every item is an instrument or carries one): ivory linen shirt with rolled sleeves under a navy wool sleeveless tabard whose chest is PLAIN — no emblem, no ring, no shape of any kind; ONE chestnut leather harness strap running from the right shoulder diagonally to the LEFT hip where it carries an olive waxed-canvas satchel with brass corners; ONE chestnut leather waist belt whose buckle closes the tabard; chestnut leather laced bracers on both forearms; navy wool trousers; chestnut leather buckled boots. Staff: a plain dark walnut shaft with small brass ferrules at the foot and the tip — NO ring, NO head-piece, NO shape atop it. NO insignia anywhere on the character: every surface is plain and undecorated — no trim, no edge ornament, no sigils, no compass diagrams, no studs. Register: painted 2D, illustrated, clean material planes, restrained surface texture, no conspicuous brush or pixel grain. Light: single key from SCREEN UPPER-LEFT, deep cool low-value ambient, readable shadows never pure black, slight rim on the key-facing edge; no spell glow; NO floor shadow. Flat uniform pure #00ff00 background covering the whole canvas; do not matte. Image 1 is the IDENTITY REFERENCE: keep the face, hair mass, skin, costume, materials, pose, framing and register EXACTLY — change ONE thing only: remove the cleft from the chin and soften the chin and jaw into a smooth, rounded feminine line. Nothing else changes; no insignia anywhere; the staff stays plain with brass ferrules.
